title: PNP-CIDG issues 40 subpoenas over 521-kg Laos shabu shipment
summary: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP)-Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) has issued 40 subpoenas in connection with the 521-kilogram shabu (methamphetamine) shipment…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP)-Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) has issued 40 subpoenas in connection with the 521-kilogram shabu (methamphetamine) shipment intercepted from Laos. CIDG Director PMGen. Robert Alexander Morico II said 11 of those subpoenaed were among the “persons of interest” previously identified by Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla. “There are about 40 subpoenas that were issued sa case na ito. Yung previous na sinabi is 21 but there were more but not all of them are persons of interest,” Morico told reporters on Wednesday. READ: PNP summons over 21 individuals for Laos drug shipment probe (There are about 40 subpoenas issued in this case. The previously reported number was 21, but there were more, although not all of them are persons of interest.) Morico said they had gathered all the documentation and CCTV footage and would submit their findings to PNP chief Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. on Friday before these were turned over to the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency. /dl READ: Remulla
